name: 999,Victory -Return-
source:
Once, by her own strength, she defeated the Demon Lord and came to reign as the new Demon Lord.

The protagonist, a former village-born sister, was recognized as a noble lord and entrepreneur who contributed to the kingdom.

Surrounded daily by fine wine and lavish feasts, she lived happily as a wealthy hero.

One day, after several years, she was invited by the first prince, “Dalt,” upon his return to the royal palace, and went to a small castle…
translation:
曾经，她凭借自己的力量击败了魔王，成为了新的魔王。

主角是一位出身乡村的姐妹，被公认为对王国有贡献的贵族领主和企业家。

日日美酒大餐，她过着富贵英雄般的幸福生活。

数年之后的某一天，她受到第一王子“达尔特”返回王宫的邀请，前往一座小城堡……
